title: The Proposed Fuel Reaches Nine Hundred Times the Sulfur Limit
subtitle: Russian ministries asked whether farmers could accept diesel or heating oil with sulfur concentrations far beyond the tolerance of modern agricultural engines.

source.name: Russian Ministry of Energy proposal described in the weekly source text

data.label: Modern diesel limit
data.annotation: Equivalent to the 0.001% sulfur ceiling cited for modern engines.

data.label: Fuel offered to farmers
data.annotation: The proposed 0.3% to 0.9% range is 300 to 900 times the cited limit.

supportingFacts.label: The proposal also asked whether farmers could use heating oil instead of road diesel.
The source text warns that modern agricultural engines would be damaged by such fuel.

metadata.keyFinding: The proposed fuel contains hundreds of times more sulfur than the cited limit.
